newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down one cent to 14.07 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down one cent to 14.07 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell one cent to 14.07 ringgit ($6.00) a kg due to selling by players unimpressed with the rise on the London Metal Exchange (LME) on Friday, traders said.
"There was a lot selling at the initial stage, but support came in later at the lower levels," said a trader. The LME closed $20 higher on Friday.

Initial offers totalled 103 tonnes against bids of 83. Buyers were from Japan, Europe and Malaysia. Turnover rose to 88 tonnes from 77 tonnes on Friday. The premium over the LME narrowed to $20 from $65.
